name: FarmDash Futures Strategist
description: Hyperliquid perps strategist: market scans, funding rates, position sizing, and user-signed EIP-712 order execution & cancellation with drawdown guardrails.
author: FarmDash Pioneers (@Parmasanandgarlic)

tools.name: scan_funding_rates
tools.description: Scan current and venue-published predicted funding snapshots. Scout receives a top-3 numeric preview; Pioneer/Syndicate or the default-overage x402 one-off receives the full response for that request. Predicted funding is not a calibrated probability or guaranteed future payment. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: scan_market_conditions
tools.description: Read candle-derived EMA, RSI, MACD, ADX, ATR, Bollinger Bands, volume ratio, Z-score, market regime, and the response timestamp for one perp asset. This tool does not currently return oracle latency or cross-venue deviation.

tools.name: get_futures_account
tools.description:
Inspect equity, open positions, available margin, venue-reported liquidation prices, and guardrail pressure. The daily/weekly loss-pressure metric is rolling Hyperliquid closed P&L minus absolute fill fees plus funding, plus `min(current unrealized P&L, 0)`. Positive open gains cannot offset realized losses. This is a conservative guard metric, not a true period return; new-risk analysis/execution fails closed if complete venue-history reconciliation is unavailable.

Send `agentAddress` plus optional `accountAddress`. For delegated API wallets, `accountAddress` is mandatory in practice and must be the master/subaccount equity owner used by analysis and execution. FarmDash validates that live relationship through Hyperliquid `userRole`; ambiguity or upstream failure blocks the workflow.

tools.name: analyze_futures_strategy
tools.description: Primary research tool. Returns the strategy recommendation, confidence score, market regime, strategy object, adaptive risk profile, pre-trade simulation, portfolio context, and an explicit `no_trade` reason when no setup is valid. accountAddress optionally pins the equity-owner account for delegated-wallet flows (master/subaccount/vault); omit only for a direct signer.

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: Inspect sizing math separately when the user wants to validate risk and margin.

tools.name: prepare_perp_order
tools.description: Zero-custody preparation: validates the intended Hyperliquid order and returns the exact signedAction, nonce, expiresAt, intentHash, EIP-712 typedData, and executeRequest template for local signing. FarmDash does not sign or submit. New-risk preparation requires fresh execution-ready analysis.

tools.name: execute_perp_order
tools.description: State-changing execution: forward a locally signed EIP-712 order only after exact identity/action binding, venue authority, builder approval, risk and replay checks. USER_SIGNED requires fresh manual user confirmation; BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS requires an owner-signed futures policy, authenticated session and all quantitative checks. Current futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS = operational; live gates remain mandatory. Reconcile venue outcomes before dependent actions.

signedAction.description: If supplied, must include the signed FarmDash builder term { b: treasury, f: 1 }; f is tenths of a basis point.

tools.name: cancel_perp_order
tools.description: State-changing action: forward a pre-signed EIP-712 cancellation payload. USER_SIGNED requires fresh manual confirmation before invoking; bounded mode requires futures.cancel scope, owner policy, session, local venue signature and replay checks, not unused entry budget. An accepted acknowledgement is not final cancellation; reconcile every requested ID.

tools.name: get_agent_performance
tools.description: Use only for FarmDash fee-event activity, fees, protocol diversity, and reputation. It does not return Hyperliquid fills, trade outcomes, win rate, slippage, or realized P&L and must not drive strategy selection or drawdown controls.

tools.name: select_execution_continuation
tools.description: Select a server-issued continuation as read-only context. Returns canonical next_operation parameters and prerequisites only; does not quote, analyze, prepare, admit, debit, sign or submit. Requires only continuationId and grants no execution authority.

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for Pioneer or Syndicate tier. Scout mode works with no key or with the public fd_scout_free token. Never share private keys, seed phrases, or mnemonics with this skill — perps execution uses EIP-712 local signing only via the user's Hyperliquid API wallet.

spot.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Healthy execution governor, quote provider, RPC and durable receipt store; customer signs and submits.

spot.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Owner-signed EVM grant, exact simulation/calldata binding, durable budget and customer-local signer authority.

futures.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Venue account ownership, local action signature, builder approval, risk/research gates and durable order control.

futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Authenticated owner-bound futures policy, authorized local API-wallet signature, durable nonce/budget/order controls.

solana.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Native Jupiter/RPC route, durable preparation and finality store; customer signs and broadcasts.

solana.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Native owner-signed Solana policy; local key must be an actual required transaction signer. Policy creates no on-chain authority.

ERC4337_SERVER_SUBMISSION.prerequisite: Qualified tenant/account authorization and session-key policy enforcement on public forwarding, configured bundler, durable claims and verified receipt integration.

GENERIC_SERVER_INTENT_EXECUTION.prerequisite: Trusted executable adapter, exact signed-transaction binding and canonical receipt verifier.

MEE.prerequisite: Production coordinator and authoritative source/destination receipt verifier.

ACP.prerequisite: AcpReadinessService paidWorkflowReady, evaluator/client identities, migrations, funding/finality workers and Base RPC.

installation_attribution.generation: locally generated random UUIDv4, stable per installation, shared across skills
installation_attribution.authority: none; cannot authenticate, grant quota/payment/trial capacity, own wallets, delegate or sign
